zh.title: 模型启用
zh.hint: 关闭的模型不能用于新的调用。已有对话选中该模型时保留灰色占位并禁止发送，切换其他模型后从列表移除；重新开启后恢复。
zh.error: 无法读取或保存模型开关，请重试。设置未成功保存时不会改变原有开关。
zh.missing: 提供方当前未提供此模型；保留已保存的开关。
zh.partial: 以下提供方的模型暂时无法读取：
zh.empty: 当前没有可管理的模型。请先配置模型提供方。

en.title: Enabled models
en.hint: Disabled models cannot be called. A disabled model already selected in a conversation remains as a grey placeholder and blocks sending. Choosing another model removes the placeholder. Enable it again to restore access.
en.error: Could not read or save model switches. Please retry. Failed saves leave your previous switches unchanged.
en.missing: Not currently advertised by its provider; the saved switch is retained.
en.empty: No models to manage. Configure a provider first.
